goal: Separate system runtime failures like disk or memory errors from block validity checks
Stop non-validating routines from taking validation state objects solely to signal fatal errors
reviewability: Needs a rebase due to conflicts with master, but the logic is ready to review now
agreement: Broad concept support for value-based error returns over exceptions (hodlinator, l0rinc)
Objected that returning expected errors risks chain splits and slows sync versus exceptions (purpleKarrot)
Objected that error handling changes alter miner returns and validation callbacks (optout21)
Concerned that adding a fatal error type broadens kernel maintenance surface (arejula27)
Warned that flattening returns into booleans lets fatal errors appear as invalid blocks (alexanderwiederin)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it clarifies kernel error reporting as an incremental cleanup
Removes internal error enumerations from the C API without unblocking kernel consumers

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes an architectural hazard where callers conflated hardware errors with invalid blocks
Unblocks cleaner validation return semantics across core chainstate routines
